name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively maintained with frequent releases across multiple supported branches. The latest stable release is v0.64.1 (Enterprise: v1.64.1), released on October 7, 2025, with v0.64.0-beta having shipped on September 24, 2025. Multiple older branches (v0.63.x, v0.62.x, v0.58.x) continue to receive patch updates in parallel, indicating long-term support commitments. Release notes are available at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases, with both Open Source and Enterprise editions distributed via Docker and JAR.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license (Metabase Commercial Software License)
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases across several branches in September–October 2025
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud (managed cloud) is available at metabase.com
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, MongoDB, Druid, Presto/Trino, Spark SQL, Athena, and more via drivers

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers more advanced visualization and enterprise features but is proprietary, significantly more expensive, and not self-hostable in the traditional sense.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash integrates tightly with dbt for a metrics-layer-first approach, making it great for dbt users but less flexible for teams without a dbt setup.
